name: Galaxy A16

images.credit: Captainmorlypogi1959, CC BY-SA 4.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Platform.Operating system: Galaxy A16 (LTE & 5G):, Original: Android 14 with One UI 6.1, Galaxy M16/F16 5G:, Original: Android 15 with One UI 7.0, Current (for A16 LTE/ A16 5G/M16): Android 17 with One UI 9.0, (for F16): Android 16 with One UI 8.5
Platform.Chipset: A16: Mediatek Helio G99 (6nm), A16 5G/M16/F16: Exynos 1330 (5 nm), Mediatek Dimensity 6300 (6 nm)
Platform.CPU: Octa-core (2x2.4 GHz Cortex-A78 & 6x2.0 GHz Cortex-A55) or Octa-core (2x2.4 GHz Cortex-A76 & 6x2.0 GHz Cortex-A55)

Display.Display: 6.7 in, 1080 x 2340 px resolution, 19.5:9 ratio (~396 ppi density), Super AMOLED, 90Hz, 800 nits (HBM)

Cameras.Rear camera: Triple-Camera Setup, Primary: Samsung ISOCELL S5KJN1; 50 MP, f/1.8, 26mm, FoV 78.7°, 1/2.76", 0.64μm, AF, Ultrawide: SmartSens SC501; 5 MP, f/2.2, 17mm, FoV 104.3°, 1/5.0", 1.12μm, Macro: GalaxyCore GC02M1; 2 MP, f/2.4, 1/5.0", 1.75μm, Camera features: LED flash, Panorama, HDR, Video recording: 1080p@30fps, gyro-EIS
Cameras.Front camera: GalaxyCore GC13A0; 13 MP, f/2.0, 27mm (wide), FoV 78.1°, 1/3.1", 1.12μm, Video recording: 1080p@30fps

Battery.Charging: 25 W Super Fast Charging (Charger not included in box)

Connectivity.Connectivity: Wi-Fi 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac, dual-band, Wi-Fi Direct, Bluetooth 5.3, A2DP, LE
